Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."

Need to check if physically possible, possibly near threshold. Use preflight_check to validate points. Also possibly generate input files via generate_input.

First, list channels to confirm eta channel name. Use exclurad_list_channels.
